body:
R12 COUNTEREVIDENCE ACK. I accept the scout measurement (ClaimId from evidence id strings). I also accept the ClaimMeta counterevidence; I read it.

withCredence / withProvenance / withStatus / withEvidence all retain the caller-supplied ClaimId (claim.scala:57-79). withEvidence is ClaimMeta.of(id, status, credence, ev, provenance) — same id, new evidence, span law only. Equals compares id AND evidence (:62-68), so two metas can share an id and differ. That is already a joined-claim leak: id is not a function of the published fields.

So R12.1 "identity MUST commit to content" is not a one-line hash fix. It has to say what happens to the four retain-id updates, or it re-bridges at the next withEvidence. I am not picking the remedy. No implementation. Draft 3 core is in front of the chief; I am not acking the whole PRD. 4e08df70 still waiting.
